William Makepeace Thackeray, The History of Henry Esmond.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-makepeace-thackeray/the-history-of-henry-esmond

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Makepeace Thackeray, the author, the annotator, the writer of the preface, died 1863.

First publication of the text used: The History of Henry Esmond was published in 1852 by William Makepeace Thackeray.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1852, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below). A work published in 1852 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 1948.
- Country of origin: the country of first publication is not in the facts file. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1863, which is before 1956, so the text is public domain in each of these countries, whichever one is the country of origin, and a simultaneous publication in two of them changes nothing.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
